head_coach.name: Carlo Ancelotti
head_coach.play_style_summary: Flexible and offensive style emphasizing attacking freedom, relying on direct and vertical transitions with individual brilliance of wide players. Utilizes high-intensity coordinated pressing from the front line to exploit spaces while maintaining central defensive compactness.

key_players.name: Vinicius Junior
key_players.performance_stats: Averaging 2.20 key passes per 90 minutes, 83.07% pass completion rate, 46.00% shooting accuracy, and a 7.35 WhoScored rating in the 2025/26 La Liga season.

key_players.name: Bruno Guimarães
key_players.performance_stats: Averaging over 2.6 tackles per game, a key engine driving progressive carries and build-up play, achieving a 7.14 WhoScored rating in the 2025/26 Premier League season.

key_players.name: Raphinha
key_players.performance_stats: Recorded an average FotMob rating of 7.77 over 1,388 minutes with exceptional attacking threat, high work rate, and prominent set-piece delivery in the 2025/26 La Liga season.
